description: This file defines a PHP class `EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams` which extends a base filter parameters class. It encapsulates filtering parameters specific to searching employee immigration records, including properties like employee number and record number, along with their respective getter and setter methods. The class also sets a default sort field upon instantiation.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for employee immigration record search filters, including employee number and record number, with default sorting.

properties.name: ALLOWED_SORT_FIELDS
properties.description: A constant array defining fields allowed for sorting.

properties.name: number
properties.description: Record number as an optional string.
